htm-preact-3.1.1.js is htm 3.1.1's "preact/standalone.module.js" bundle
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/htm), unmodified. It contains:

- htm 3.1.1, Apache License 2.0, Copyright 2018 Google Inc. (htm-LICENSE.txt)
- Preact and Preact hooks, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2015-present Jason Miller
  (preact-LICENSE.txt)

It's vendored so the web UI works offline with no build step.
